digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V, App. VI

teaser.en: 'Bloom in a new field': a tree believed to flower almost as soon as land is cleared.
teaser.sw: 'Chanua katika shamba jipya': mti unaoaminiwa kutoa maua karibu mara tu ardhi inapofyekwa.
teaser.dg: 'Tuluza maruwa munda muphya': muhi ambao atu anaamini unatuluza maruwa mara tu munda uchitemwa.

summary.en: Mtsomatsanje is Drypetes reticulata, a tree of coastal forest. Its name, 'bloom in a new field', reflects the belief that it flowers very quickly in newly cleared land.
summary.sw: Mtsomatsanje ni Drypetes reticulata, mti wa misitu ya pwani. Jina lake, 'chanua katika shamba jipya', linaakisi imani kwamba hutoa maua haraka sana katika ardhi iliyofyekwa karibuni.
summary.dg: *Mtsomatsanje* ni *Drypetes reticulata*, muhi wa matsaka ga pwani. Dzinare, 'tuluza maruwa munda muphya', rinaonyesa vira atu anavyoamini kukala unatuluza maruwa upesi sana kpwenye munda muphya uriotemwa.

about.en: Mtsomatsanje is a small to medium evergreen tree with alternate, leathery leaves, often with a slightly toothed margin and a fine net of veins (hence reticulata). Male and female flowers are on separate trees, small and greenish, and the fruits are small, round and fleshy. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsomatsanje ni mti mdogo hadi wa wastani wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, majani yanayopishana, magumu kama ngozi, mara nyingi yenye ukingo wenye meno kidogo na mtandao mwembamba wa mishipa (ndiyo maana ya reticulata). Maua ya kiume na ya kike huwa kwenye miti tofauti, ni madogo na ya kijani, na matunda ni madogo, ya mviringo na yenye nyama. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Mtsomatsanje* ni muhi mdide hadi wa chiasi, wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kupishana, ni mafu dza chingo, mara nyinji genye meno madide sana kanda-kanda, na mishipa midide iriyotsanganyika dza chimiya (ndiyo sababu ya dzina *reticulata*). Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwenye mihi tafwauti; ni madide na ga chijani-chijani, na matunda ni madide, ga mviringo na genye nyama. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani na vitsakani pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

culture.en: Pakia records the belief that the species blooms (tsoma) very quickly in a new field (tsanje), and the name records that belief. Pakia groups it with Mkula usiku, the 'grow by night' plant.
culture.sw: Pakia anarekodi imani kwamba spishi hii huchanua (tsoma) haraka sana katika shamba jipya (tsanje), na jina lake linahifadhi imani hiyo. Pakia anaiweka katika kundi moja na Mkula usiku, mmea wa 'kukua usiku'.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala atu anaamini aina hino inatuluza maruwa (*tsoma*) upesi sana kpwenye munda muphya (*tsanje*), na dzina hiri rinahifadhi imani hino. Pakia anauika phamwenga na *Mkula usiku*, mmea 'unaokula usiku'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsomatsanje, also written Mtsoma tsanje, meaning 'bloom in new field'. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Drypetes reticulata.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsomatsanje, linaloandikwa pia Mtsoma tsanje, lenye maana ya 'chanua katika shamba jipya'. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Drypetes reticulata.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsomatsanje*, ririroandikpwa piya *Mtsoma tsanje*, ririro na mana ya 'tuluza maruwa munda muphya'. Takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Drypetes reticulata*.

reason.en: Also named for a belief about how it grows
reason.sw: Nao pia umepewa jina kutokana na imani kuhusu jinsi unavyokua
reason.dg: Piya una dzina ra imani kuhusu vira unavyokula

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa misitu ya pwani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa matsaka ga pwani

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa misitu ya pwani
